status: frozen before any Stage60 arm was simulated or scored

free.multiplier: earlier-trained penalty-free constant exp(a); 1.0 where no earlier election exists

penalised.multiplier: Stage48 earlier-trained ridge constant K, read from data/processed/balance-scale/fit.json; reference only, never recommendable

components.representativeSeats: first, middle and last seat of each election

fit.objective: Stage48 per-seat-normalised Gaussian negative log likelihood with equal environments and equal seats, constant free, b_R = b_T = 0
fit.independentCheck: Powell, objective agreement <= 1e-6, projected gradient <= 1e-6, central-difference gradient <= 1e-6
fit.trainingFrozenScale: each earlier election enters with the frozen Stage45 fold scales in force for that election, as in Stage48

descriptive2026Refit.meaning: value the free arm would take for the 2026 forecast; reported, never scored

decision.primary: mean over seats of the mean CRPS of that seat's National and Labour candidates (pp), 193 seats of 2017/2020/2023

coverageFloor.rule: arm coverage >= min(nominal - nominalMargin, control coverage - alreadyUndercoveringMargin) at every election and level; coverage is the pooled N/L candidate coordinate coverage
coverageFloor.justification: 0.10 is about 1.6 binomial standard errors at 50% and 2.0 at 80% for 64 seats, so only a clearly sampling-noise-exceeding miss fails; an election the control already under-covers may lose at most a further 0.05

selection.best: qualifying arm with the lowest pooled N/L major CRPS on the decision seats
selection.withinNoise: lower end of the 90% paired seat-bootstrap interval of CRPS(arm) - CRPS(best) is <= 0

bootstrap.scheme: seats resampled with replacement within election, pooled equal-seat mean

selection.chosen: least aggressive (highest equal-seat mean multiplier on the decision seats) qualifying arm that is within noise of the best
selection.descriptiveAlternative: least aggressive qualifying arm within 0.01pp pooled CRPS of the best, reported only

composedWidthImplication.arithmetic: per ablation seat, width(m)^2 = width(no_candidate_balance)^2 + (width(full)^2 - width(no_candidate_balance)^2) g(m); g = m^2 if the multiplier is taken to scale all balance variance (upper bound of effect), g = s m^2 + (1 - s) if only the seat part scales, s = seat^2 / (seat^2 + shared^2) from the seat's frozen fold balance scales (Stage48 scales only the seat part)
composedWidthImplication.sanityCheck: same arithmetic with the Stage48 penalised multipliers against the Stage48 composed K-versus-control National full-90 width change
composedWidthImplication.status: approximate, nine seats, not a composed bank; composed precision gates remain unmet
